other_conditions: Applicant must be affiliated and registered with the Handloom Association
The applicant’s family must own a handloom
Only one benefit per weaver family regardless of the number of looms owned
Applicant must be present in the Departmental Database
Applicant must be engaged in handloom weaving and earn livelihood from weaving
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹24,000 per eligible weaver family to modernize equipment and compete with powerloom products.
